arStrings.szText: Generate {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}Resolve{/c} per enemy hit.

{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} is now a Core Skill and can be Channeled, costing {c_resource}{SF_13}{/c} Faith to initially cast and a consumes an additional {c_resource}{SF_14}{/c} Faith per second to continue casting. While channeling you have {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} and smashing into enemies counts as blocking.

{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} is now a {c_important}Judicator{/c} skill and charging through an enemy can consume {c_important}Judgement{/c}.

The final impact of this skill instead releases a holy nova that Stuns enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:STUN}{/c} seconds and deals {c_number}[SF_25*100|%|]{/c} increased damage for each {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} consumed by {c_important}Shield Charge{/c}, up to {c_number}[SF_25*SF_26*100|%|]{/c}.
Surge forward, scooping up enemies in your path and knocking them forward. At the end of your charge, send out a wave of holy damage for {c_number}{payload:END_BURST_C}{/c} Damage.
